post_export_checks.when: right after the download, before anything else touches the export. These read listing ids and per-block counts only; they are not a read of the seal.
post_export_checks.1: listing-id disjointness: the c19 ids against every id of the 21 prior export files (the list in cut_c19_c20.py EXPORT_FILES) and the post-heal re-exports of trial, c17 and c18. Expected 0.
post_export_checks.2: label disjointness: the c19 ids against operator_labels.jsonl, operator_merges.jsonl and must_not_link.jsonl of the newest labels artifact downloaded before R1's freeze (the 09-26 artifact 36225845749 at least). Expected 0.
post_export_checks.3: heads disjointness: the c19 ids against the listing ids of the D1-1 BEFORE dump (the 9,514 images v1 was trained and scored on). Expected unknown.
post_export_checks.4: size: per-block and total listing counts from the export's summary.json, recorded in the freeze addendum. A total outside 15,000-18,000 is recorded, not a reason to re-cut; a block that returns 0 adverts is recorded.
post_export_checks.rule: If checks 1-3 together flag more than 1 % of the cohort's adverts, cohort 19 is VOID and re-cut by the same rule (towns ranked 27+ that are not in cohort 20). Otherwise every group holding a flagged advert is left out of both sampling frames below, and the flagged ids are listed in the freeze addendum.

seal.rule: Read ONCE, at R1's freeze. Nothing about cohort 19 beyond post_export_checks is computed, printed or read before the freeze addendum is committed to this file.
seal.allowed_before_the_freeze: the export, its download, post_export_checks, the DINOv3 embed, and `lab build c19` (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md B-c: c19 built, not read). NOT allowed: `lab run`, `lab board`, `lab lost`, `lab page`, `harness run` or `harness evaluate` on c19; any judge (LLM) run on c19 pairs; any operator look at a c19 group.
seal.freeze_addendum: appended here and committed BEFORE the first c19 run: R1's frozen code sha (the R1 PR head), the settings file name and sha256 (w31r1.json, or w31r1 without image_tags under fallback 2), the model file and sha256 (w6_gold), the head model id and its identity (fp32 twin or bf16) or 'none', the reference R0 (w31 at origin/main at the same moment), the c19 export run id and cohort.jsonl.gz sha256, the labels artifact used in check 2, and post_export_checks' results.
seal.no_leak: No c19 read enters cohorts.json (the lab registry /home/hejtm/autodedup-artifacts/w15/global_search/g3/cohorts.json, key group_reads) or the rulings (POST /autodedup/verdict, the page's verdict_bodies) before R1's go/no-go is recorded in a second addendum. The reads are kept under /home/hejtm/autodedup-artifacts/w15/global_search/preregistrations/c19_reads/ until then. After the go/no-go, the reads are posted and c19 becomes search ground for MF (section 2.1).
seal.second_read: A second read of cohort 19 is forbidden (section 6 risk 5). If R1 is refused here and re-frozen (fallback 2 or 3, or any other change), the changed R1 is NOT re-read on c19; it needs a fresh cohort cut by this rule from what remains (never cohort 20, which is MF's).

read_protocol.frames: M4 frame = the groups R1 forms that R0 does not (the lab review's groups_gained: a group of >= 2 adverts whose member set is not an R0 group). M5 frame = the R0 groups R1 breaks up (autodedup/lab/page.py `splits`: an R0 group wholly inside an R1 group is absorbed, not lost, and is asked about through the R1 group). Groups holding an advert flagged by post_export_checks are left out of both frames.
read_protocol.draw: each frame sorted by its sorted member-id tuple, then random.Random(20260927).shuffle(frame), drawn separately for each frame with a fresh generator; the first 40 of each are read (all of them if fewer than 40). The drawn keys are written to c19_reads/draw.json before the page is shown. Where a tool draws differently, this draw governs.
read_protocol.page: one private review page (B-i) per frame, 40 + 40 cards (RP2c, about 35 minutes at ~25 s a card). Each card shows every member's portal link and stated facts, and its decided pairs. The page does not say which arm formed the group.
read_protocol.verdict: binary: 'One property' or 'Not one property'. A card left unanswered counts AGAINST R1: as fused in M4, as one property (a true group R1 lost) in M5.
read_protocol.classification_D7: Pre-registered (GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 2.2, decision D7): a group is FUSED when any two members state a different value of any fact (area, floor or its wording, disposition, price while co-live, part of town, room size in the body, unit designator, cellar or accessory, ...), UNLESS an operator ruling covers the pair, or an operator ruling on a convention covers the difference (identical units are one property; a floor-numbering convention). 'Inside the engine's tolerance' is not an excuse. Undecidable counts against the arm. Standing rulings apply: a rental is never one property with a sale; a flat is never one property with a commercial unit; image tags are never facts. The operator reads; the operator's read is final (operator rulings override), and a 'One property' read against a stated difference is recorded with that difference.
read_protocol.wilson: fused shares are reported with the 95 % Wilson interval; 0 of 40 bounds the fused share at <= 8.8 %.

bars.B2_gains: WAVES.md:87 (D83 + D91) on the seal, through M4 (section 2.2): 0 fused among the drawn R1-only groups under D7. The R1-only groups not drawn are listed (count and member ids) in the read record. The operator-'different' clause is vacuous on c19 (no rulings), so the read alone decides.
bars.M5_losses: the reverse read (section 2.2): the drawn R0-only groups read; every 'One property' is a true group R1 loses, listed with the fact R1 reads between its members (`lab lost --why`, B1's form). REPORTED with its Wilson interval, beside the estimate 'true groups gained minus lost' = (R1-only groups x M4 one-property share) - (R0-only groups x M5 one-property share). B1 itself is read on the post-heal trial, c17 and c18 (section 3.5), not here.
bars.readouts: computed once, from the same two runs, at the same opening, never bars on c19: M7 (co-pairs gained / lost, groups changed, band size, largest group); certain-duplicate recall (cohort 16's pinned builder truth16.py, engine-free) R1 vs R0, against arm H's per-cohort bar (>= R0 - 0.10 pp, G4 section 6); same-body re-post trains newly split (arm H: 0); M9 decide wall R1 / R0.
bars.not_computable_here: M1, M2 (no operator rulings on c19), M3 (no fixture pair lives in c19), M6.

refusal_rule: ANY fused group among the drawn R1-only groups (a 'Not one property' read or an unanswered card) REFUSES R1 as frozen on this ground: R1 is no-go at RP2c. The fused card is attributed from the two single-change arms (w31r1 minus image_tags; w31r1 minus d43_image_facts), run on c19 after the read, and GLOBAL_SEARCH.md section 4's fallbacks 2 or 3 name what may ship; per 'second_read' any re-frozen R1 confirms on a fresh cohort. M5 does not refuse automatically: if the estimate of true groups gained minus lost is negative, the go / no-go is the operator's at RP2c with those numbers, recorded in the second addendum.
verdict_forms: GO (0 fused in M4, M5 reported, estimate >= 0), OPERATOR (0 fused in M4, estimate < 0: the operator decides at RP2c), NO-GO (>= 1 fused in M4), VOID (post_export_checks flag > 1 %), NOT-MEASURABLE (a run or the freeze addendum is missing).
